profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Moloco | Ex-Amazon
profile.summary: An SWE with 20+ years of software engineering experience, 4+ years of team management experience, and 4+ years of Cloud infrastructure cost management experience. Successfully supported the world's largest sports event traffic (IPL '23 '24) of 30M+ concurrent live viewers with 10+ engineers. Operating the largest service infrastructure in Moloco supporting 8M QPS. Currently leading a org-wide cost efficiency improvement initiative.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer / TLM
positions.description: Serving Platform / System

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
TL in the Moloco Commerce Media organization
- Large-scale migration projects for storage systems such as Redis, MySQL, and AlloyDB
- TL for MCM-wide cost optimization

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer / TLM
positions.description:
Managing the Moloco "Service & Development Infrastructure" team
- Growing team from 2 to 10+ engineers (Seattle, Redwood City, and Seoul)
- Led the development of the company-wide IaC, CI/CD, GKE platforms servicing 8M+/sec requests
- Designed infra automation products such as Infra Provisioning as a Service
- Led the infra development for the world's largest sports event (IPL '23, '24)
- Engineering side representative of security and compliance

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer for the Moloco Cloud product infrastructure
- Developed an auth server for the Moloco's first Cloud product
- Led the legacy campaign storage migration
- Led the legacy Ad Exchange integration layer improvement
- SKAN integration

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Alexa Shopping / Alexa Experience and Device
- Alexa Shopping Conversation Engine Integration
- Alexa News Data Storage System Design & Development
- Alexa News Video Player Migration

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead for the Amazon's website navigation bar component
- Led the pilot project ("App Nav") to revamp the mobile app navigation bar
- Perl to Java Web navigation bar migration
- Web navigation bar integration support for the other Amazon webpages
- Led the Web navigation performance improvement and optimization

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cloud Development Team
- OpenStack-based cloud management API development
- Cloud datacenter network design
- Dev unit leader (leading 2 junior engineers)

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Researcher and Developer
- Network Management Middleware Development (CORD) for large-scale network management
- Protocol stack development including (1) ICN SW router, and (2) OpenFlow controller
- For the ICN SW router development project, handled all aspects of the development from the protocol simulation with NS-3, prototyping with raw sockets, socket implementation, TCP-like traffic control mechanism implementation, and a file system implementation over ICN protocol
positions.insights: Skills: C · C++ · Java · Openflow · SDN

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: Managed the development process of Essue.com (closed permanently), and also worked as a software development engineer.
